scoped_evidence_policy.source_of_bound: RD181/2008 Article 11, 2023 BOE annual compliance report 312/312 ordinary editions published before 08:00; assuming edition classification and publisher's self-report, day+1 at midnight Madrid is conservative availability proxy

security: No user-selected arbitrary source imported into internal two-document registry
Caller can select known document id and as_of; result is documentary availability under assumption only
Real-person scoring and release_grade always false
Unknown document, naive timestamps and before-bound requests rejected
limitations: Not a live API, not validator of external request to ingest arbitrary original PDF
Publisher annual report and legal guarantee don't prove precise individual CDN upload time
Document is evidence of 2023 source facts, not an independent cross-legislature person ID
Pdfsig current certificate status expired, SHA1 signature algorithm; full historical PKI audit missing
ABR: No separate scientific discovery beyond C13.
